decisions.statement: The token reaches this process through the environment.
A token is the letters `wt_` followed by sixty-four hex characters.
Space around the token is trimmed before the shape is judged.
A token of the wrong shape is refused rather than sent.
An unset token is refused rather than treated as an empty token.
A minted token would not match the hash the server verifies against.

definition: the enrolment token the watcher worker proves itself to the server with
